main_text.head: NOMINA PROPRIA NOVI TESTAMENTI
A.
main_text.p: Ἀρῶν ὁ nomen viri Hebraum ἀxλι-ῷν, h.e. indeclinabile, montanus.
Ἀδαδδὼν nomen Antichristi Hebr. q.d. vastator, Graece Ἀπολλύων.
Ἀδὲλ nomen viri Hebr. ἀxλιῷν. vanitas.
Ἀδιὰ nomen viri Hebr. ἀxλιῷν. q.d. pater meus est Dominus.
Ἀδιὰδ nomen viri Hebr. ἀxλιῷν. decus patris.
Ἀδιάδωξ ὁ nomen viri Hebr. ἀxλιῷν. pater excellens.
Ἀδιλλωὴ ῆς ἡ nomen regionis Hebraum, patris mansio.
Ἀδρεσὰμ nomen viri ἀxλιῷν, Hebr. pater celsus multorum.
Ἀγαδῶ ῆ ὁ nomen viri, Syr. qui gerit officium.
Ἀγὰξ ἡ nomen serva seu pellicis ἀxλιῷν, Hebr. peregrina.
Ἀγρίππας α ὁ nomen viri, Latin. Agrippa pro Ægrippa, ab ægro partu.
Ἀδὰμ nomen primi nostri parentis Hebr. ἀxλι-

page.notes: Left margin fragment belongs to a neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Greek entries are rendered approximately; several Greek words and the Hebrew gloss ἀxλιῷν (Hebrew transliteration) are doubtful and should be checked against the scan. Printed page number "503" reads as "503" at the head.
